real_useful_behavior: From one high-level goal, construct and execute a causally correct tool DAG whose downstream actions depend on live upstream results, including multi-source state propagation, runtime branching or fan-out, durable synthesis, and independent end-state verification.
why_this_is_the_smallest_high_leverage_s: Single-tool execution does not test orchestration.
A fixed linear chain does not test runtime-dependent planning.
Fan-out alone, conditional execution alone, and multi-source joins alone are already separately proven in canonical Brain evidence.
The first unproven integration boundary is composing those already-proven operators into one causal DAG without hand-authored controller actions.

frontier_reference_evidence.role: Canonical normalized external frontier evidence already recovered by Brain; frontier behavior is the bar, not provider implementation.

frontier_reference_evidence.behavior_used: Tool orchestration with intermediate-result processing, chaining/parallelism, conditions, loops, and next-action selection.

frontier_reference_evidence.source: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 official capability evidence
frontier_reference_evidence.behavior_used: Complex multi-tool agents, planning, coordination, and long-running autonomous work.
